question: As per the Indian Minerals Yearbook 2015, which state was the largest producer of mica in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The production of mica (waste and scrap) at 11,852 tonnes in 2014-15 decreased by 40% compared to the previous full year.
 
• **Andhra Pradesh** continued to be the **leading producing state** with a **contribution of 64%**, followed by **Rajasthan (24%)** and **Bihar (12%)**.
 
• The most important mica-bearing pegmatites occur in **Andhra Pradesh, Bihar, Jharkhand, Maharashtra, Odisha, Rajasthan** and **Telangana.**
 
• Occurrences of mica pegmatites are also reported from Gujarat, Haryana, Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu and West Bengal. 
 
• Imports of mica (total) increased slightly to **2,240 tonnes in 2014-15 **from **2,049 tonnes in the previous year**.
